- "Gold price retreats on stronger dollar" (mining.com, 2020-08-07). Reported move: down 1.2%. Reason: stronger dollar. Quote: "Gold price retreats on stronger dollar" (source: cdba8522dc8ea981)
- "Dollar gains , stock rally ebbs after labor report" (financialpost.com, 2020-08-07). Reported move: down 2%. Reason: Dollar bounced off two-year lows after labor report. Quote: "the dollar bounced off two-year lows" (source: ea7877f3d7393d54)
Pointing the other way, 2 reports from that day:
- "Gold , Silver Price News : Gold Futures Top Rs 56 , 150 For First Time , Silver Near Rs 77 , 950 Amid Rising Coronavirus Cases" (ndtv.com, 2020-08-07). Reported move: up, size not stated. Reason: Rising Coronavirus Cases. Quote: "Amid Rising Coronavirus Cases" (source: 3ee9e38c880f8ec7)
- "Gold smashes record high as coronavirus pandemic worsens" (indiatoday.in, 2020-08-07). Reported move: up 0.6%. Reason: coronavirus pandemic worsens. Quote: "Gold smashes record high as coronavirus pandemic worsens" (source: 2c66639235b4c69e)
